bio.text: Luis R. Sepúlveda represents the 32nd District in the Bronx in the New York State Senate, according to a May 2026 El Diario NY profile.
El Diario reported that he has nearly 15 years in the state legislature and is the first Latino and Puerto Rican chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee.
The article reports that he grew up in the Los Sures neighborhood of Brooklyn.

sources.title: Senador de NY Luis Sepúlveda: los puertorriqueños le abrieron las puertas políticas a otros hispanos en el estado
